node.title: Canonical rank bases globalize every fixed kernel chart
node.closure: common quotient translation plus generalized-MDS extension capacity
node.statement: For every rank-r deficient component eleven-subset in the ten-dimensional residual correction space, choose one canonical rank basis B and put d=10-r. All records over B lie after one common affine translation and exact basis cancellation in one d-dimensional explanation family. The d+1 remaining tuple coordinates are common zeros of its kernel space, so only K'-10 additional zeros and at most C(K'-10,d+1) extensions are available per record. A fixed basis therefore carries at most M_d C(K'-10,d+1) incidences, with the proved margin/interleaving cap at d=9.
